intervention_and_comparator: Biscuits fortified with iron 6 mg, zinc 5.6 mg, iodine and vitamin A, 5 days a week, with or without albendazole, against unfortified biscuits
main_result: Haemoglobin +1.87 g/L, plasma zinc +0.61 umol/L; risk of anaemia, zinc and iodine deficiency cut by more than 40%; cost under USD 0.08 a serving
relevance_to_plant_protein: A school food vehicle with about 5.6 mg zinc works in Vietnamese schoolchildren; the protein source is irrelevant to the result

ages: school children with low serum zinc
intervention_and_comparator: Extruded rice fortified with zinc, iron and vitamin A in school lunch (about 8 mg extra zinc a day) against normal rice
main_result: Zinc deficiency fell to 29% (fortified) and 39% (control); control also improved through the lunch and milk programmes
relevance_to_plant_protein: School lunch fortification raises zinc status; ordinary lunch plus milk also helps

intervention_and_comparator: Seasoning powder fortified with zinc 5 mg, iron 5 mg, vitamin A and iodine in a central school lunch
main_result: Odds of zinc deficiency 0.63 and iodine deficiency 0.52 against unfortified; no effect on anaemia
relevance_to_plant_protein: Fortifying a lunch component works for zinc; iron is harder

intervention_and_comparator: Regular milk or fortified milk with inulin against a reference group
main_result: Weight-for-age and height-for-age improved; underweight and stunting fell by 10%; anaemia fell and zinc improved in all groups including control
relevance_to_plant_protein: The dairy comparator any plant product faces in schools; allocation method not stated in the abstract

intervention_and_comparator: 200 g milk and a 50 g egg every school day against control
main_result: No height difference; boys gained 0.6 to 0.7 kg more; better vitamin D, broad jump and shuttle run
relevance_to_plant_protein: Even daily milk and egg did not change school-age height: school protein is not a stunting lever

design_and_size: two schools, one per arm (school randomised), 400 children
intervention_and_comparator: Local-food school meal with soybean, over one third of daily needs, 5 days a week, against no meal
main_result: Height gain 3.8 against 3.3 cm; haemoglobin improved; no effect on serum zinc, ferritin or retinol
relevance_to_plant_protein: The only soy school-meal trial found; weak design; soy meal did not raise zinc status

intervention_and_comparator: Meat against micronutrient-fortified cereal as first complementary food
main_result: No difference in linear growth; stunting rose in both arms
relevance_to_plant_protein: Fortified cereal performed as well as meat for growth

main_result: Length gain 13.01 against 12.75 cm; smaller fall in length-for-age; more than half of the 18-month deficit was present at 6 months
relevance_to_plant_protein: Modest meat advantage; stunting is largely set early

intervention_and_comparator: Local products with small fish (and spiders) against corn-soy blends CSB+ and CSB++
main_result: No difference between local animal-source products and corn-soy blends
relevance_to_plant_protein: Micronutrient fortification may matter more than the protein source; CSB++ contains milk
